eps.d: To warm up her Ice Palace, Kootie Pie Koopa kidnaps Mama Fireplant from Dome City. Because Mama provides the heat for the city, the Marios must rescue her from Kootie Pie before the cave people freeze.
Mario introduces the cave people to cars -- and the problems that come with them.
Yoshi must enter a haunted forest to rescue Mario and the others from Magikoopa.
Mario and Luigi introduce Christmas to Dinosaur Land, but Koopa takes all the gifts.
Luigi tries to help the cave people farm crops, but Cheatsy and Monty Moles sabotage their efforts.
Magikoopa turns Luigi into an egg and Cheatsy and Bully challenge Mario and Yoshi to football.
Princess Toadstool starts a school, and a few of the Koopalings happen to be among her students.
Luigi tells Yoshi about how he found and raised him.
